# SD18 deterministic Human Druid level 11 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E4/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Druid
# level-1..level-10 prepared divine spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/fixtures/rules_core/pf1_human_druid_level10_sd13_deterministic_input.txt)
# to level 11 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic
# ability/feat posture from the level-1 through level-10 fixtures, and the
# same canonical nature-bond selection (animal companion), adding only the
# level bump this bounded slice needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Druid burden surface: no animal
# companion stat block/advancement/link-share-spells, no spellbook, no
# spells prepared, no spell slots, no spell DCs, no bonus spells, and no
# level-12+ progression. The PF1 CRB Druid class table's level-11 "Special"
# column is genuinely blank (verified independently against both d20pfsrd
# and legacy.aonprd.com — neither source lists any new class feature at
# 11th level; the level-10 "Wild shape (4/day)" entry does not rise again
# until 12th level, "Wild shape (5/day)"), so this fixture makes no new
# class-feature claim at level 11 either way. Base attack bonus genuinely
# rises to +8 (11 * 3 / 4, up from +7 at level 10); base saves stay
# numerically unchanged from level 10 (both good saves 11/2+2=7, poor Reflex
# 11/3=3, integer-division coincidences); Wild Empathy genuinely rises to 12
# (11 + Charisma modifier 1); Nature Sense, Woodland Stride, Trackless Step,
# Resist Nature's Lure, Venom Immunity, and the nature-bond choice
# recognition all carry over unchanged — so no new pillar is grounded at
# level 11, only the existing pillars are widened (mirroring exactly how
# Barbarian's/Bard's/Cleric's own level-11 widenings were grounded).
case_id=pf1-crb-human-druid-level11
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:druid:11
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:12
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:druid_nature_bond:bond:animal_companion
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
